correctness.rationale: PASS: For even k>=4, odd q>=3, d=q(k-1)-1 even and L=d/2. A diameter path of length d holds d+1 vertices, producing a (k,d)-clique. Any larger set meets three arms; an extending k-subset with one vertex from each cannot be on any simple path, proving omega=d+1. A supposed q-coloring must have every palette color exactly k-1 on each of the 3 diameter paths because each has q(k-1) vertices. For any noncentral color, counts a_i of its occurrences on arm i satisfy a1+a2=a1+a3=a2+a3=k-1, forcing 2a_i=k-1, impossible as k even. Thus chi>=q+1. At k=4,q=3 a depth mod4 four-coloring realizes chi=4, omega=9 on S(4,4,4). This uses diameter paths, not unchecked finite enumeration. Independently checked parity and diameter counts for (k,q)=(4,3),(4,5),(6,3),(8,3).
